The '''Ralme system''' was a system in [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. It contained at least four [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Ralme IV]], where [[Lant Mining Corporation]] conducted surface, underground, and [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Mining/Legends|mining]] operations to extract metals.
